svg.title: Logical request, versioned adapter, physical attempts, and timing clocks
svg.desc: A scheduled logical request waits for a worker. Before transport work, the selected versioned endpoint adapter serializes the exact request and declares request media, accepted response media, and framing. The separate built-in transport opens a fresh HTTP/1.1 connection for the physical attempt. After connection setup and immediately before every physical inference POST, a command-local no-wait runtime guard atomically reserves query, token, and exact serialized-byte budget; a denial sends no POST. The transport uploads the request and returns bounded response chunks. The adapter validates declared media and framing, folds provider events into canonical state, normalizes usage, and classifies terminal outcome. Compatibility, credential, or transport fallback repeats adapter serialization, fresh connection setup, and admission. Failed and partial attempts remain in reliability and occupancy evidence; primary latency requires clean acceptable outcomes, while token metrics require clean rows with trustworthy usage and explicit coverage. Exact caller clocks use the scheduled target, while final-attempt request-path clocks start immediately before the request call. The canonical result and terminal admission evidence are appended to the durable journal.
svg.text: One logical row can contain more than one physical inference attempt
